sn2.28:1.1: At [pli-tv-bu-vb-pc2]() = [ja28]() we meet an ox of this name. Perhaps the virtuous beast was reborn as a god, still concerned with pulling laden carts. Pāṇini lists it as a name, but no such individual has been identified in Sanskrit.
sn2.28:2.1: These verses are also at [sn1.29](); see notes there.
